items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: But they had, he used Emile O'Reilly most of the time.

ctx.x: Emile O'Reilly played. Often on, they didn't have, you know, they had different guitar players. Sometimes he couldn't have a regular guitar player. After you know, they played, they didn't be playing spot jobs would it, you know? Yeah. But they had, he used Emile O'Reilly most of the time. Now that was a band that was a country band. That band was more out of town than it was in town. They'd take all up the road, up there, around Emile. Uh, Lacombe, Viola Combe, Viola Fush, Lake Charles, Shreesport. We just lived…
